name: Time Tracker
author: nabdalla
description: A free time tracker app for Omarchy: one click on an activity starts its timer. Events log, a pie-chart timeline by day, week, month or year, daily and weekly goals, CSV export. The bar shows what's running; click it to open the app. Fully local: nothing leaves your machine.

barWidget.description: The running timer; click to open Time Tracker

schema.label: Show the activity name next to the timer
